$comment: Claude plugins. settings.json's enabledPlugins would fetch these on next launch anyway; install.sh does it up front so a fresh machine works on first run. `commit` records what this machine has — bump it, re-run, and the diff is reviewable.
$required: caveman and claude-hud are non-negotiable: caveman is the response-compression mode and claude-hud is the statusline. doctor.sh fails if either is absent. The third mandatory piece, rtk, is a host binary — see shared/manifests/deps.json.
$notPlugins: firebase and playwright are deliberately absent. Both were installed as plugins, but only their tools are wanted, not their skills — see claude/mcp.json.
$noCommit: The claude-plugins-official entries carry no `commit`. That marketplace is fetched as a tarball, not cloned — its dir has a .gcs-sha and no .git — so the gitCommitSha Claude Code recorded for them is not an upstream identity at all: resolving HEAD from inside the install dir walked up into ~/.claude and captured that repo's own HEAD. A pin that can only ever match the machine it was written on enforces nothing, so there is nothing to record.

caveman@caveman.why: token-compression response mode; also owns the caveman-statusline badge used by claude/statusline.sh

claude-hud@claude-hud.why: the statusline; rendered by claude/hud-statusline.sh, needs bun
